AboutPage.title: About

bio.paragraph1: ZHENGYU HUA is a junior at Pratt Institute and a photographer based between New York City and Ningbo. He picked up a camera two years ago and has been documenting his travels across cities ever since — each destination a new chapter in his visual diary.
bio.paragraph2: His work captures quiet moments, material details, and the fleeting poetry of urban life. His approach is slow and observational — every image is an attempt to see something more clearly, to hold a moment still long enough to understand it.
